frosty.linePrev: I never know what time of year it is living on top of the fire
frosty.line: But the robin outside has to hunt and hide in the cold frosty shire
frosty.lineNext: Ah but he knows just what goes in between his cold toes and his warm ears
stanza: I never know what time of year it is living on top of the fire
But the robin outside has to hunt and hide in the cold frosty shire
Ah but he knows just what goes in between his cold toes and his warm ears
And he's got no disguise in his eyes for his love as she nears
